code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        nz = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if not nz:
            continue
        last = nz[-1]
        color = row[last]
        start = last
        while start > 0 and row[start - 1] == color:
            start -= 1
        if last - start + 1 >= 2:
            for c in range(last + 1, len(row)):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
